vlae.teks: Hulle het ook gesterf aan longontsteking wat vandag dikwels met pille genees kan word.
vlae.rede: Placing the PP after the participle ('gesterf aan longontsteking') is less usual than 'aan longontsteking gesterf', but it keeps the protected phrase together with its relative clause; it is acceptable as it stands, so no change is proposed.
